# Platformer

> > Platformer is an independent tech newsletter covering AI policy, platform governance, and the intersection of technology with democracy and public interest.

Platformer, founded by Casey Newton, provides in-depth analysis of Silicon Valley's most pressing issues, with particular focus on AI ethics, military applications of AI, content moderation, and Meta's strategic decisions. The publication combines investigative reporting with expert commentary on how technology companies shape society.

## Key Topics

- AI policy and governance
- OpenAI and Sam Altman
- Anthropic and Pentagon
- Meta and Mark Zuckerberg
- Content moderation
- Autonomous weapons
- AI ethics and safety
- Social media platforms
- Military AI applications
- Platform design and regulation
- Section 230 liability
- Encryption policy
- AI transparency
- Tech industry accountability

## AI Policy & Military Applications

- [Inside the backlash to the AI war machine](https://www.platformer.news/openai-protest-military-ai-movement): Coverage of OpenAI protests and Pentagon's military AI involvement concerns
- [What is OpenAI going to do when the truth comes out?](https://www.platformer.news/openai-pentagon-surveillance-drones-backlash): Analysis of Sam Altman's Pentagon deal and public backlash to military AI
- [The authoritarian AI crisis has arrived](https://www.platformer.news/anthropic-pentagon-authoritarian-ai): Investigation of Anthropic-Pentagon conflict and authoritarian AI risks

## Platform Governance & Content Moderation

- [The infinite scroll goes on trial](https://www.platformer.news/the-infinite-scroll-goes-on-trial): Coverage of Zuckerberg testimony on platform design and Section 230 liability
- [Why Meta is retreating from encryption](https://www.platformer.news/instagram-encryption-meta-whatsapp): Analysis of Meta's encryption policy changes for Instagram and Messenger

## AI Transparency & Ethics

- [Grammarly turned me into an AI editor against my will and I hate it](https://www.platformer.news/grammarly-expert-review-reviewed): Investigation of Grammarly's unauthorized AI expert review feature
